title: Jeff Williams
name: Jeff Williams
summary: Application-security leader who helped found OWASP and co-founded Contrast Security.
whyThisMatters: Jeff Williams helped create OWASP in 2001 and is a founder and CTO of Contrast Security. Conference and company biographies credit him with major OWASP projects, including the Top 10.

sections.overview:
Jeff Williams is an application-security leader and co-founder of Contrast Security.

OWASP

Company and conference biographies state that he helped create OWASP in 2001 and served as its Global Chairman.

They also credit him with contributions including the OWASP Top 10 and related application-security materials.

Contrast Security

Williams later co-founded Contrast Security, where he has served as CTO.

timeline.event: Jeff Williams is documented in security history sources.
